description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage internet marketplace company to build the data systems behind reliable pricing estimates. You will turn noisy sold-listing data into trustworthy comparable items and pricing signals, working closely with computer vision partners.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and own scheduled ingestion pipelines for sold-listing data from multiple marketplaces and external sources.

 - Develop entity resolution that links inconsistent listing text and images to canonical items.

 - Create valuation logic that estimates prices from comparable sales, accounting for recency, condition, and the number of comps.

 - Build production monitoring to identify data drift, fraud, stale comparisons, and other quality issues.

 - Partner with computer vision teammates to define item matching across sources with varying levels of detail.

 - Evaluate build-versus-buy options for data sources, licensing, and third-party pricing feeds.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 5 years of data engineering experience, including ownership of large-scale production ETL and data pipelines.

 - Experience working with messy, adversarial data in marketplaces, pricing, fraud, or a similarly noisy domain.

 - Strong SQL skills and experience with modern data tools such as dbt, Airflow or Dagster, and Spark or similar technologies.

 - Experience with entity resolution or record linkage at scale, and production data quality monitoring.

 - Exposure to statistical estimation or pricing models, including regression-based comparable-sales logic.

 - Experience ingesting data from multiple external sources and making technical build-versus-buy decisions.

 - Pricing intelligence, data licensing, and early-stage startup experience are helpful.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $160,000 to $220,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

Hybrid role based in New York, New York.
